evidence_quotes: een verzoek van het Wetterskip om nadeelcompensatie afgewezen.
het verleggen van transportleidingen voor afvalwater in verband met werkzaamheden aan de provinciale infrastructuur.
rationale: This Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerns a claim for administrative loss compensation (nadeelcompensatie) brought by the regional water board (Wetterskip Fryslân) against the Province of Fryslân for approximately €800,000 in costs incurred relocating wastewater transport pipelines (transportleidingen voor afvalwater) due to provincial infrastructure works. Because the dispute directly governs wastewater infrastructure operated by a water board and the allocation of costs for relocating sewage/wastewater trunk lines, it is substantively about water/wastewater infrastructure (WATER under both labels) and best fits sanitation_sewage, without involving household connection refusal or informal settlements.
